description: This file implements a Text-to-Speech (TTS) service using the Hume API within a larger speech synthesis framework. It defines the HumeTTSService class which manages TTS synthesis requests, streams PCM audio, handles word timestamping, and supports runtime configuration updates.

classes.name: HumeTTSService
classes.description: A TTS service class integrating Hume's API to generate speech with word timestamps and PCM streaming capabilities.

classes.name: HumeTTSService.InputParams
classes.description: Optional parameters for controlling the speech synthesis behavior such as description, speed, and trailing silence.

methods.name: None __init__( self, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, voice_id: str, params: Optional[InputParams] = None, sample_rate: Optional[int] = HUME_SAMPLE_RATE, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Initializes the HumeTTSService with API key, voice ID, optional parameters, and sample rate.

methods.name: bool can_generate_metrics(self)
methods.description: Indicates that this service can produce metrics related to TTS performance.

methods.name: None start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the TTS service, resetting internal state.

methods.name: _reset_state(self)
methods.description: Resets internal state variables related to timing and start status.

methods.name: None stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the service and cleans up resources like the HTTP client.

methods.name: None cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Cancels ongoing operations and releases resources.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Handles incoming frames and manages internal state accordingly.

methods.name: None update_setting(self, key: str, value: Any)
methods.description: Allows runtime modification of voice and synthesis parameters such as description, speed, and trailing silence.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[Frame,None] run_tts(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously generates speech from input text, streaming audio frames along with word timestamp frames.
